ideas.text: An AI that turns your LinkedIn post into a humble brag without you having to do the humbling part yourself.
A bot that detects when you've opened LinkedIn without a plan and closes the tab after 30 seconds.
An app that scores your 'I'm excited to share' post by how excited anyone actually is.
A tool that converts a LinkedIn thought leadership post back into the 2-sentence email it started as.
An AI that detects when your headline is lying about what you actually do and suggests a more accurate one.
A bot that auto-comments 'This is so insightful!' on your connection's posts while you sleep.
An app that counts how many 'I learned 5 things' posts you've published and warns you before you become a content creator.
A tool that detects when a LinkedIn comment is fishing for a speaking gig and flags it for everyone.
An AI that generates a layoff announcement post that gets maximum engagement while minimizing actual information shared.
A bot that removes connections who have never interacted with a single post and sends them a formal notice of severance.
An app that detects when someone is clearly in an engagement pod and awards a badge of complicity.
A tool that rewrites your LinkedIn summary so it doesn't start with 'I am a passionate' anything.
An AI that estimates how long your viral LinkedIn post took to write versus how long it took to peak.
A bot that detects when a recruiter message is clearly a template and responds with an equally templated decline.
An app that replaces 'I'm honored to announce' with what you actually mean, which is 'I got a new job.'
A tool that tracks how many endorsements you've received for skills you've never used and calls it a crisis.
An AI that detects a LinkedIn post starting with a one-word sentence for dramatic effect. Like this. And flags it.
A bot that estimates your follower count in 5 years if you keep posting at current frequency and warns you.
An app that blocks you from posting on LinkedIn for 24 hours after any career setback to protect you from yourself.
A tool that converts your job description on LinkedIn into what the actual day-to-day looks like.
An AI that detects when your LinkedIn post is really just a complaint formatted as professional advice.
A bot that sends connection requests on your behalf to anyone who liked a post you liked.
An app that translates 'open to opportunities' into a confidence-adjusted probability that you're actively applying.
A tool that automatically endorses people for skills the moment they endorse you, regardless of whether they have those skills.
An AI that detects when a 'thought leadership' post is really just a summary of a Wikipedia article.
A bot that alerts you when a former manager has viewed your profile 3 times in one week.
An app that writes your first LinkedIn post for people who've been on the platform since 2014 and never posted anything.
A tool that scores your profile photo on a scale of 'taken at a wedding' to 'actually meant for this purpose.'
An AI that detects when you're posting inspirational content at 6am while your actual work is on fire.
A bot that identifies which connections congratulated you on your new job without reading what the job was.
An app that reads your last 10 posts and tells you what personality type LinkedIn thinks you're performing.
A tool that detects when a LinkedIn post ends with 'what do you think?' but the author doesn't respond to any replies.
An AI that writes your recommendations for people you like so you both don't have to experience the awkwardness.
A bot that catches you word-for-word plagiarizing a post structure that went viral 6 months ago.
An app that calculates how long your 'building in public' series will last before you quietly stop posting.
A tool that detects when you've tweaked your headline for the 11th time this month and locks it.
An AI that detects 'I failed and here's what I learned' posts and estimates whether the failure was real or brand content.
A bot that translates '3 lessons from my startup journey' into their equivalent business school case study.
An app that detects when you've spent 90 minutes crafting a post that got 4 reactions and offers condolences.
A tool that scores how much of your LinkedIn activity is research for a job you're too scared to apply for.
An AI that estimates the probability that a glowing recommendation was written by the person it's for.
A bot that detects when you're checking an ex-manager's LinkedIn instead of doing work and closes it firmly.
An app that converts your 15-slide LinkedIn carousel back into the tweet it was always trying to be.
A tool that tracks how many people viewed your profile after you liked their post and generates a surveillance report.
An AI that detects when 'let's connect' messages are from people who want something and never say what.
A bot that removes skills you haven't used in 5 years from your profile before a recruiter sees them.
An app that blocks you from accepting connections from people whose last activity was endorsing someone's skills in 2019.
A tool that detects when a job posting is real versus a LinkedIn ghost listing that has been up since the Obama administration.
An AI that monitors your competitor's LinkedIn page and sends you a weekly alert titled 'things to not copy.'
A bot that detects when you've written a post about work-life balance at 1am and reschedules it for when it will be ironic instead of tragic.
An app that identifies the post type most likely to get you hired at your dream company and then tells you it involves dancing.
A tool that calculates the ROI of your personal brand relative to the hours spent maintaining it.
An AI that detects when your LinkedIn post is subtweeting your previous employer and suggests 'private journal entry' instead.
A bot that identifies all the connections you haven't spoken to since adding them and mass-archives them as acquaintances.
An app that prevents you from posting the same insight twice by cross-referencing your previous 400 posts.
